column1: 2.2.5.3 Quad Digital Receiver. The Quad Digital Receiver (QDR) is a sub-system of
an ELINT system and measures the pulse parameters of radar in real time. The radar
signal of 0.5 –18 GHz will be down converted to an IF using suitable Front End Receiver
and fed to Quad Digital Receiver. This sub-system is built around Ultra High speed, Low
Power, High Performance 10 bit ADC’s and Xilinx 7 series FPGAs.
